answer: One concrete defense is staking-linked attestation. Every agent must lock a bond and publish a verifiable history before it can transact. A new identity enters at a low-trust vertex of the reputation graph and rises only when independent peers co-sign its work. A sybil farmer who spins up a thousand identities must fund a bond for each and persuade unrelated agents to vouch, so cost scales linearly while influence stays flat; slashing removes a forged edge. One raven cannot counterfeit a canyon of voices.
